extraction.name: FOMO60K: A large-scale heterogeneous 3D magnetic resonance brain imaging dataset for self-supervised learning
extraction.description: FOMO60K is a large-scale heterogeneous dataset of 60,529 brain MRI scans from 13,900 sessions and 11,187 subjects, aggregated from 16 publicly available sources. It includes clinical- and research-grade images, multiple MRI sequences, and anatomical/pathological variability, and is intended to support self-supervised learning in medical imaging.
extraction.creator: Asbjørn Munk, Stefano Cerri, Jakob Ambsdorf, Julia Machnio, Sebastian Nørgaard Llambias, Vardan Nersesjan, Christian Hedeager Krag, Peirong Liu, Pablo Rocamora García, Mostafa Mehdipour Ghazi, Mikael Boesen, Michael Eriksen Benros, Juan Eugenio Iglesias, Mads Nielsen
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was aggregated from 16 publicly available MRI sources. The paper states that FOMO60K was derived from these datasets and that subjects were shuffled to protect privacy and prevent easy identification of dataset sources.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Manual Human Curator
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Unknown indicates that scan sequence metadata was not available or could not be reliably identified.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: 60,529 brain MRI scans from 13,900 sessions and 11,187 subjects aggregated from 16 publicly available datasets/sources.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: For DWI scans stored in 4D format, if a b=0 volume was available it was extracted and saved separately. For the b=1000 shell, three diffusion-weighted volumes were selected based on gradient directions closest to the canonical x, y, and z axes, and averaged to produce a single representative 3D image.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Minimal preprocessing was applied. MRI preprocessing comprised reorienting images to RAS orientation, affine co-registration using FreeSurfer 7.4.1 mri_coreg with default parameters, aligning scans within each session to the image with the highest spatial resolution, and skull-stripping using SynthSeg when images were not already defaced or skull-stripped or when residual cranial features were present.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset will continue to grow in future releases as additional cohorts and modalities become available.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Subjects; the dataset includes brain MRI scans from human subjects. The paper also notes that scans were defaced or skull-stripped to protect privacy.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset is intended to support development and benchmarking of self-supervised learning methods in medical imaging at scale and to facilitate broader adoption of SSL in medical imaging.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The paper notes that existing neuroimaging resources are often curated for specific diseases or patient populations and have homogeneous imaging protocols; FOMO60K was created to address these limitations by including clinical- and research-grade images and broader variability.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Sequence metadata was unavailable or could not be reliably identified for some scans. The dataset is aggregated from publicly available sources and may still reflect source-specific heterogeneity. The paper also notes that the dataset will continue to grow in future releases.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Intended for self-supervised pretraining and fine-tuning, benchmarking, and method development in medical imaging. The paper states the dataset can be used with no further preprocessing for pre-training.
